review:
A retrowave 3x3 with a twist: a spinning arrow points at the grid, and when the scatter lands at its tip you get the Wheel of Fortune bonus, which stops on a prize boosted by any multipliers in play.

Respin multipliers add extra wins in the base game, and Chance x2 doubles your odds of the good stuff for a slightly higher bet. The best bit is the pace – the bonus comes round roughly once every 20 spins on average, so it never feels dead. Medium volatility, 3,600x max and an outstanding 97.33% RTP.
pros: Excellent 97.33% RTP – among the highest published
Bonus lands relatively often (about 1 in 20 spins on average)
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
